text:
Alex: quick sync — pushed the new runtime overview dashboard to staging, includes token_latency_p95, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_queue_length, and slo_burn_rate. want owners for alerting and pager rules. :eyes:
Mira: nice, can you paste the dashboard link and the proposed alert signals?
Alex: https://staging-console/redwood/dashboards/runtime-overview (staging)
Alex: proposed signals:
- token_latency_p95 > 800ms for 5m (high)
- kv_cache_hit_rate < 65% for 15m (medium)
- model_queue_length > 250 (short spike) or > 100 sustained 10m (high)
- slo_burn_rate > 2 for 10m (page)
Dan: for queue_length can we use per-pool and global? we should avoid noisy pages from transient imbalances. suggest alert on 95th perc per-pool + a global sum for sustained overload.
Sasha: agreed. map per-pool alerts to pool-oncall rotation, global to infra-oncall.
Mira: on the SLO burn rule, do we have an established runbook link? if not, i'll draft one.
Priya: pager mapping proposal: per-pool -> #runtime-pool-oncall (pagerduty POLL), global -> #infra-oncall (pagerduty SEV). Can we set automatic dedupe for identical symptoms?
Alex: yes dedupe via alertmanager grouping on alertname + pool_id. snippet below:
```
- alert: RuntimePoolQueueSustained
  expr: sum by (pool_id) (increase(model_queue_length[10m])) > 100
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: runtime
  annotations:
    runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/runtime-queue
```
Mira: looks good. for kv_cache_hit_rate this will likely be noisy after deploys; put a 15m window and label with deploy_id so we can silence per-deploy.
Dan: telemetry question — are we emitting pool_id consistently from the serving runtime? i remember earlier gaps for ephemeral pools.
Alex: yes we added pool_id and model_variant tags in last week's PR, but there are a couple of old hosts not rolled. ops-bot: rolling upgrade in progress: 12/300 hosts remaining. ETA 3h.
Sasha: okay hold non-critical medium alerts off until rollout completes. can we set ambient suppression with label release_track=rolling?
Priya: for pager routing we also want a fallback escalation after 10m if not acknowledged -> go to eng-sre. is that acceptable?
Mira: yes, escalation to eng-sre after 10m. also add an automatic annotation with last_deploy and top5_callers (top traced APIs) to help triage.
Alex: i can add annotations. can we get a review from eng-sre on threshold sensitivity? Sasha can you own that?
Sasha: i'll take it. will spike false-positive rate by simulating 2-week historical windows and post results here tomorrow.
Dan: one more ask — Console UX: can we expose an "acknowledge+silence-for-deploy" button that tags alerts with deploy_id? product wants that before GA.
Mira: noted, will add to rollout UX doc, linking to alertmanager silences API.
Alex: thanks all. next steps: 1) Sasha runs sensitivity scan, 2) Alex pushes updated alert rules with grouping and annotations, 3) Mira drafts runbook + UX doc, 4) Priya wires pager mappings and escalation policy. check-in tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled test page to infra-oncall at 2005013000 UTC for validation (will auto-cancel if tests pass).
Priya: acked, i'll monitor the test and report back.
Sasha: started the sensitivity run, posting a short report in ~3h.
